object_context: First strict analytic Riemann-Hypothesis atom: before inventing any new inequality, localize the candidate-independent obstruction inside RH-equivalent analytic criteria. Use Weil's explicit-formula quadratic/sign criterion as the primary representation and compare Li positivity, Nyman-Beurling approximation, zero-density/critical-line mollifier methods, and prime-zero explicit-formula control. The task is to identify exactly which infinite-uniformity, test-class, or sign-control step remains unproved without assuming RH; no mathematical candidate exists yet.
structural_coordinates: the Riemann zeta function has meromorphic continuation, a functional equation, and nontrivial-zero symmetries about the real axis and the critical line
the root claim is universal: every nontrivial zero must lie on Re(s)=1/2, so finite zero verification cannot close the problem
Weil's explicit formula converts a sum over nontrivial zeros into prime-power local terms plus an archimedean contribution on an admissible Mellin-test class
Weil's criterion converts RH into a sign condition for an infinite class of multiplicative autocorrelation test functions satisfying two moment constraints
Li's criterion converts RH into positivity of an infinite sequence of zero-dependent coefficients with an arithmetic explicit-formula representation
Nyman-Beurling-Baez-Duarte converts RH into an L2 closure/approximation statement, again requiring an infinite limiting assertion
mollifier and Levinson-type methods prove substantial but partial critical-line occupancy and depend on mean-value estimates rather than a universal all-zero mechanism
any useful analytic transfer must preserve exact transform conventions, convergence/order of zero sums, endpoint conditions, and uniformity over the required infinite family
an equivalent reformulation has zero root authority unless it exposes a strictly cheaper independently provable sub-obligation
the active lane is analytic: operator/spectral constructions are left to the separate RH spectral lane unless an exact analytic bridge requires them
equivalent_formulations: every nontrivial zero rho of zeta(s) has Re(rho)=1/2
every zero of Riemann's xi(t) is real
Weil's RH-equivalent negativity condition for the arithmetic side of the explicit formula on the registered multiplicative-autocorrelation test class
Li's positivity criterion: all Li coefficients satisfy the required positivity condition
Nyman-Beurling-Baez-Duarte Hilbert-space closure criterion for the characteristic function under the registered dilation family
the prime-counting error bound pi(x)=Li(x)+O(sqrt(x) log x) in Bombieri's official problem description
solved_analogues: Riemann hypotheses for zeta functions of curves over finite fields, proved by Weil, where Frobenius/cohomology and an algebraic index theorem supply the load-bearing sign mechanism
Weil conjecture Riemann-hypothesis statements for varieties over finite fields, proved by Deligne using etale-cohomological structure
near_solved_analogues: Levinson-Conrey-Pratt/Robles/Zaharescu/Zeindler mollifier programs that place a positive proportion of zeta zeros on the critical line but do not control every zero
Li and Nyman-Beurling-Baez-Duarte exact criteria that are fully equivalent to RH but shift the unresolved universal step into sequence positivity or infinite-dimensional approximation

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A complicated global response is audited by writing a quadratic energy/correlation functional as manifestly signed components plus an explicitly isolated residual, then testing whether the residual can overturn the sign.
common_abstraction: quadratic functional evaluated on an entire admissible signal/test class
global spectral information encoded through correlation transforms
a universal sign claim is only as strong as control of the unsimplified residual
source_to_target_mapping: signal g -> admissible Weil test function g
autocorrelation energy -> multiplicative autocorrelation f(x)=integral g(xy) conjugate(g(y)) dy
measured quadratic response -> arithmetic side of Weil's explicit formula
uncontrolled spectral leakage/residual -> arithmetic/archimedean component whose sign is not manifest
shared_constraints: the identity must hold for the full registered test class or a proved dense core
transform and limiting operations must be justified before sign conclusions
a small or well-behaved finite sample does not imply universal sign control
disanalogies: the zeta zero side is not known unconditionally to be a positive spectral measure
the arithmetic explicit formula is not already a Gram-energy identity
engineering energy positivity does not supply an RH proof and may hide exactly the missing theorem
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Before inventing a new RH inequality, seek an exact candidate-independent decomposition of the Weil arithmetic functional into manifestly signed pieces and one named residual; the residual, not the whole criterion, becomes the next falsifiable obstruction.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Any retained decomposition must be proved on the exact Weil class (or a separately proved dense core), preserve the two moment constraints and Mellin/zero-sum conventions, and establish the residual sign without invoking RH or an equivalent positivity criterion.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Structural analogy used only to choose an audit strategy; it supplies no mathematical authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned finite-field geometry, explicit-formula positivity, Hilbert-space approximation, mollifier/mean-value methods, signal-energy decompositions, control/accounting analogies, and simple balance-sheet metaphors. Retained only the signed-energy/residual audit pattern because it yields a concrete target-domain validation obligation while making the classical-vs-positive-spectral-measure disanalogy explicit.
